description: Different model profiles should preserve bounded Go planning decisions, including direct symbol evidence, one-hop same-package dependency evidence, an untested external client, and DTO deferral.

lockedFields.reason: A conventional single-module standard-library test suite should retain the deterministic Go verification command.
The untested external payment client should remain an add-test item.
The directly exercised parser and its one-hop normalizer dependency should remain extend-test items.
The struct-only payment shape should remain deferred from direct testing.
Covered transformation logic should keep a stable extend-test item id.
The parser test must retain its exact package-symbol proof.
The imported parser function remains directly called by the runnable Go test.
The external boundary should remain a new unit-test candidate.
The bounded same-package dependency should remain a covered normalizer item.
The normalizer should retain explicit one-hop Go source dependency provenance.
The dependency evidence must remain rooted in a directly called parser entrypoint.
The struct-only DTO should remain covered through consuming behavior.

unexpectedVariations: dependency evidence propagated beyond one source hop
